payload.title: Serialize release and coverage badge writes to main
payload.description: As a maintainer, I want automated main writers serialized so successful CI can publish a release without the coverage badge racing it. Observed Release run 39046316429 fail after build because Coverage Badge run 39046316427 moved main from 807b184 to 2cb44f7. Scope: repository workflow concurrency only; retain existing CI/release gates, bot auth and shared reusable workflows. Plan: reproduce concurrency mismatch, assign the same non-cancelling group to both callers, validate workflow syntax and checks, merge via PR, follow deployment/release/PyPI. Acceptance: Given successful main CI, when Release and Coverage Badge run, then only one may write main at a time and both can finish without cancelling each other.
